game.name: USB Mouse Jiggler
game.desc: Safe module-backed USB HID mouse jiggler for RG34XXSP on muOS 2 NeXT. Configure 1-300 second intervals, smooth 1-2000 pixel movement, and four patterns using only the gamepad. A starts or stops, the D-pad opens settings, Start opens help, and B exits through reversible USB cleanup. No kernel flashing is required.
